row:
Dr. Pamela Lovell brings years of experience in non-force chiropractic to the San Luis Obispo area. 

"Focused AND accurate AND gentle treatment that produces consistent results," say Back In Place patients. 

Our Directional Non-Force Technique® (DNFT®) Chiropractic approach uses gentle, focused, precise adjustments targeted to the root of the problem you're experiencing. Dr. Pamela Lovell uses DNFT Chiropractic to go beyond traditional chiropractic to maximize the effectiveness of your body's innate ability to heal itself.
